def to_list(a):

    return [float(x) if np.isfinite(x) else np.nan for x in a.reshape(-1)]

probe("single_key_sorted_values_desc_flat", to_list(vals_desc))

probe("single_key_last2", to_list(vals_desc[-2:]))

        "A": (("x","y"), A),
        "B": (("x","y"), B),

probe("multi_key_y_order_flat", to_list(y_order))
probe("multi_key_A_flat", to_list(np.asarray(res2["A"].values)))
probe("multi_key_B_flat", to_list(np.asarray(res2["B"].values)))
